# Param Minhas

> Brand builder and creative director based in Bengaluru, India, working where culture, design and music meet. Built and ran SoleSearch, India's leading sneaker and streetwear marketplace ($6M+ GMV, 350K+ community). Now runs Cats Can Dance (culture platform for India's music scene) and Iterate (AI-native marketing agency). Makes music as Merman.

## Key Facts

- 15+ years building products, brands, and companies
- $6M+ GMV generated (SoleSearch)
- 350,000+ community built
- 40-person team at peak (SoleSearch)
- Reach today: 170K+ followers across the Instagram pages he runs
- Cats Can Dance tracks 1,000+ artists, 2,000+ nights and 150+ promoters across India
- $795K capital raised
- 30+ live events produced
- 4 companies founded/co-founded
- Featured in: VICE, CNBC-TV18, Storyboard18, Economic Times, Open Magazine, The Established, Business of Fashion

## Current Roles (2026)

1. Founder & Creative Director at Iterate (hyperiterate.com) — AI-native marketing agency. Clients: an EV charging network, an airport, a travel platform, a fintech, a co-living brand.
2. Founder at Cats Can Dance (catscandance.com) — Culture platform for India's music scene: club nights, artist directory, a database of the underground scene, Hire (gear and crews), CCD School (learn Ableton Live). Contact: hello@catscandance.com.
3. Merman — his artist project as a DJ and producer (Ableton Live, CDJ-3000, live visuals in Resolume).

## Career Timeline

- 2026–Present: Iterate — Founder & Creative Director (AI-native marketing agency)
- 2026–Present: Cats Can Dance — Founder (culture platform)
- 2025: Fere.ai — CMO (autonomous AI agents, funded by Ethereal Ventures)
- 2022–2024: SoleSearch — Founder & CEO ($6M+ GMV, 350K+ community, $795K raised)
- 2020–2022: Quartic.ai — Director of Product Marketing (enterprise AI)
- 2017–2020: Good Capital/Investopad — Partner, Growth & Technology (portfolio: Meesho, Entri, Simsim)
- 2016–2017: Octo — Founding Team, Head of Growth (AI marketing orchestration platform, acquired and became Quartic.ai)
- 2012–2015: Hab Housing — Founder (budget hospitality, bootstrapped $120K+)
- 2011–2012: GetRightPrice — Founding Team (India's first price-comparison engine)
